caveats: LMPD Youth Explorer program abuse: 7 plaintiffs (former teen Explorer cadets) sued Louisville Metro Government and Boy Scouts of America; first suit filed March 8, 2017 in Jefferson Circuit Court, moved to federal court in 2018 (one source dates the federal filing March 2018). Settled for $3.65M announced Nov 1, 2021; Boy Scouts' insurer (Old Republic) paid over $3M, city self-insurance the remainder. lawsuit_type set to civilian since cadets were program participants, not employees; multiple consolidated suits but no source calls it a certified class action. Officers Kenneth Betts, Brandon Wood, and Brad Schuhmann were convicted of federal sex crimes; Spectrum News says three officers 'pleaded guilty to federal charges', other sources say 'convicted' - criminal_status set pleaded_guilty per that source.
